name: UpdateItemTemplateInput
description: Represents the input for updating an item template.

inputFields.name: baseTemplates
inputFields.description: The base templates of the item template.

inputFields.name: createStandardValuesItem
inputFields.description: The flag indicates whether should create the StandardValues item for the template or not.

inputFields.name: database
inputFields.description: The name of the item database.

inputFields.name: deleteMissingFields
inputFields.description: The flag indicates whether fields and sections should be removed from the template that are not present in the input.

inputFields.name: icon
inputFields.description: The icon of the item template.

inputFields.name: language
inputFields.description: The language of the item template.

inputFields.name: name
inputFields.description: The name of the item template.

inputFields.name: sections
inputFields.description: The section definitions of the item template. Sections with IDs will be updated. Sections without IDs will be created.

inputFields.name: templateId
inputFields.description: The globally-unique identifier of the item template.
